model_annotation: The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of completions (k) and coverage for four different models: Llama-3B, Llama-3B + FT, Llama-1B, and Llama-1B + FT. The x-axis is labeled "Number of completions (k)" and has a logarithmic scale, ranging from 2^0 to 2^8, with tick labels at each power of 2. The y-axis is labeled "Coverage" and has a linear scale, spanning from 0.4 to 0.8 with tick labels at intervals of 0.1. The plot includes four lines, each representing one of the models: Llama-3B (dark blue, solid line, circle markers), Llama-3B + FT (green, dashed line, triangle markers), Llama-1B (light blue, solid line, no markers), and Llama-1B + FT (light green, dashed line, triangle markers). The Llama-3B line starts at approximately 0.44 at 2^0 and increases to around 0.89 at 2^8. The Llama-3B + FT line begins at about 0.45 at 2^0 and reaches roughly 0.9 at 2^8. The Llama-1B line commences at approximately 0.43 at 2^0 and rises to around 0.84 at 2^8. The Llama-1B + FT line starts at about 0.44 at 2^0 and attains approximately 0.85 at 2^8. All lines exhibit an upward trend, with the Llama-3B and Llama-3B + FT lines displaying a more gradual increase compared to the Llama-1B and Llama-1B + FT lines, which show a steeper rise, particularly at lower values of k.
